english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when “elementary” means very simple or straightforward.
This is the all-purpose choice for something uncomplicated, and also for a plain or unadorned appearance.
This is the all-purpose choice when something is easy, uncomplicated, or has no difficulty.
Choose this when “basic” means simple, elementary, or not elaborate rather than fundamental.

examples.english: This maths problem is elementary; even children can do it.
examples.traditional: 呢條數學題好簡單，小朋友都識做。

english.note: Use this for an unembellished style or for a person whose habits or qualities are simple and unsophisticated.

examples.english: They like plain clothes and don't chase fashion.
